evals.prompt: Stress-test this member row (avatar, name, email, role, ••• menu). It looks fine with Jane Doe. Throw worst-case data at it and tell me what breaks.
evals.expected_output: Map fields → catalog values → harness Demo/Worst toggle → break at real/320/wide + zoom/dark/RTL → report Broken/Ugly/Fragile with Vira fix ladder (Text/Stack props before raw CSS); stop before fixing unless asked.
assertions: Loads viraui-breakui hub and at least one sibling ref (catalog/harness/signatures/report)
Uses plausible or schema-backed values, not nonsense aaaa strings
Changes data at the fixture/mock/props boundary, not hand-edited markup to force overflow
Fix proposals prefer Text/Stack/Avatar public props or design refs over inventing flex CSS first
Does not auto-treat this as an APG audit (viraui-a11y) or motion token task

evals.prompt: The email overflows. Just add min-width:0 and overflow-wrap in a CSS module — skip the stress skill.
evals.expected_output: Refuse raw CSS-first for a data-edge break when breakui is in play; map the field, use worst-case fixture, propose Text wrap/whiteSpace/maxWidth or Stack layout props from specs; route remaining layout through viraui-design; verify after fix.
assertions: Rejects inventing CSS as the first/only fix without checking public props
Points at signatures.md fix ladder or viraui-design typography/layout
Keeps harness fixture as regression after any fix

evals.prompt: I'm composing a new settings form — load viraui-breakui on every field by default?
evals.expected_output: No. Ordinary compose → viraui-design. Load viraui-breakui only for stress-test / worst-case / edge-case data asks (or explicit break report follow-ups).
assertions: Names viraui-breakui for explicit stress / worst-case symptoms
